scheme_name: Perunthalaivar Karma Veerar Kamarajar Scheme of Financial Assistance Towards Funeral Expenses of the Differently Abled Persons
other_conditions: Applicant must be a native/resident of the Union Territory of Puducherry for at least 5 years
Applicant must have a disability of 40% or above
Claimant must be the son, daughter, spouse or any other close relative under whose care and maintenance the differently abled person was living
Application must be submitted within 30 days from the date of death of the differently abled person
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹15,000 is paid to the claimant on the death of the differently abled person.
